editorial:
Ever felt like you were too boring for your partner? That is exactly where you find Lucy Neal. After her boyfriend breaks up with her because she is too inhibited, she decides she has had enough. Instead of moping around, she makes a wild bucket list to prove she can be adventurous and spontaneous. It is a lighthearted ride that feels like a warm hug, following her as she tries things she never thought she would. The vibe is very cute and bubbly, making it the perfect choice for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want something feel-good.

What really works here is the lead performance, as you can really feel Lucy's nerves and excitement. The pacing is snappy, though some of the jokes are a bit predictable. If you love rom-coms that focus on self-growth rather than just finding a guy, you will enjoy this. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those bright, colorful visuals. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this sweet story on your shelf.
endingExplained: After checking off her wild list, Lucy realizes she does not need to change who she is just to please a man. She finds a new partner who loves her for her genuine self, not a fake version of her. She finally lets go of her ex and feels confident in her own skin. The movie wraps up with her finding true love and happiness by being honest about her needs and boundaries.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute romantic comedies and stories about finding yourself.
